[EN] The Invalesco Strikes Back
[ES] Invalesco contraataca
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The {@Rgn:46001$$Three Towers} are no place to relax. Watch your back.
[ES] Las {@Rgn:46001$$Three Towers} no son un lugar para relajarse. Cuida tu espalda.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] While the argons lick their wounds, we'll continue our work.
[ES] Mientras los argones se lamen las heridas, continuaremos nuestro trabajo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet {@LinkCreature:246#3001#Hurun} at the {@Rgn:46001$$Three Towers} Research Base.
[ES] Reúnete con {@LinkCreature:246#3001#Hurun} en la base de investigación de {@Rgn:46001$$Three Towers}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the {@LinkCreature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crushers} near the {@Rgn:46003}.
[ES] Mata a los {@LinkCreature:46#201#trituradores kulkari argonomorfos} cerca de {@Rgn:46003}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the {@LinkCreature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shamans} near the {@Rgn:46002}.
[ES] Mata a los {@LinkCreature:46#202#chamanes kulkari argonomorfos} cerca de {@Rgn:46002}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the {@LinkCreature:46#203#argonomorph Lokian slayers} near the {@Rgn:46004}.
[ES] Mata a los {@LinkCreature:46#203#asesinos lokianos argonomorfos} cerca de {@Rgn:46004}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy the {@LinkCreature:246#3010#cyasma conduits} installed at the {@Rgn:46003}.
[ES] Destruye los {@LinkCreature:246#3010#conductores de cyasma} instalados en {@Rgn:46003}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Victory for Valkyon!"
[ES] "¡Victoria para Valkyon!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report back to {@LinkCreature:246#3001#Hurun}.
[ES] Informa a {@LinkCreature:246#3001#Hurun}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
